q: Whose word came to Joel?
a: The word of Yahweh came to Joel.

q: To whom were the elders to tell the word of Yahweh?
a: They were to tell their children, and their children were to tell their children.

q: What happened to what the hopping locusts have left?
a: The destroying locust ate what the hopping locusts left.

q: Why will drinkers of wine wail?
a: They will wail because the sweet wine has been cut off.

q: Into what has the enemy made the vine?
a: The enemy has made the vine into a waste.

q: For what reason does the virgin mourn?
a: The virgin mourns for the death of her young husband.

q: What has happened to the grain?
a: The grain has been destroyed.

q: What has been withheld from the house of God?
a: The grain offering and the drink offering have been withheld from the house of God.

q: When will the day of Yahweh be here?
a: The day of Yahweh is almost here.

q: What has been broken down?
a: The storage places for grain have been broken down.

q: Why are the herds of cattle suffering?
a: The herds of cattle are suffering because they have no pasture.

q: To whom does Joel call?
a: Joel calls to Yahweh.

q: For whom do the animals of the field pant?
a: The animals of the field pant for Yahweh.

q: Why should all the inhabitants of the land tremble in fear?
a: They should tremble in fear, for the day of Yahweh is coming.

q: When has there been an army like this one?
a: There has never been an army like this one, and there never will be again.

q: What is the land like behind the army?
a: The land behind the army is a ruined wilderness.

q: In what way does the locust swarm look and act like an army?
a: The locusts look like horses and run like horses.

q: How does the army enter the city?
a: They rush on the city, they run on the wall, they climb in houses, and they go through windows like thieves.

q: Whose army is this?
a: This is Yahweh’s army.

q: What should the people tear?
a: They should tear their hearts and not their garments.

q: Why should the people return to Yahweh?
a: He is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abundant in love, and he would like to turn from inflicting punishment.

q: Why should the people blow a trumpet in Zion?
a: They should blow a trumpet to consecrate a fast and to call a sacred assembly.

q: What had Yahweh’s people been among the nations?
a: Yahweh’s people had been a reproach, an object of scorn, among the nations.

q: Why should the land not fear?
a: The land should not fear, because Yahweh has done great things.

q: Who sent the mighty army?
a: Yahweh sent the mighty army.

q: Will Yahweh ever bring shame on his people again?
a: No, he will never bring shame on his people again.

q: What will happen when Yahweh pours out his Spirit?
a: Their sons and your daughters will prophesy, their old men will dream dreams, and their young men will see visions.

q: What will Yahweh show in the heavens and on the earth?
a: Yahweh show wonders in the heavens and on the earth.

q: Into what will the sun turn?
a: The sun will turn into darkness.

q: Who will be saved at that time?
a: Everyone who calls on the name of Yahweh will be saved.

q: Who will Yahweh bring to the Valley of Jehoshaphat?
a: Yahweh will bring the nations to the Valley of Jehoshaphat.

q: Who did the nations scatter?
a: The nations scattered Yahweh’s people.

q: At whom are Tyre, Sidon and all the regions of Philistia angry?
a: Tyre, Sidon and all the regions of Philistia are angry at Yahweh.

q: What did Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia do with Yahweh’s treasures?
a: They brought his treasures into their temples.

q: What did Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia do to the people of Judah and Jerusalem?
a: They sold the people to the Greeks in order to remove them far from their territory.

q: What will Yahweh do to the sons and daughters of Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia?
a: Yahweh will sell their sons and daughters to the Sabeans by the hand of the people of Judah.

q: Into what should the nations beat their plowshares?
a: They should beat their plowshares into swords.

q: What will Yahweh do to all surrounding nations?
a: Yahweh will sit to judge all surrounding nations.

q: What will happen to the sun, moon, and stars?
a: The sun and moon will become dark, and the stars will withdraw their brightness.

q: What two things will Yahweh be for his people?
a: Yahweh be a shelter and a stronghold for his people.

q: Who lives in Zion?
a: Yahweh their God lives in Zion.

q: With what will the hills flow?
a: The hills will flow with milk.

q: Who will be abandoned because of the violence they did to the people of Judah?
a: Egypt and Edom will be abandoned.
